paragraphs.text: dsh-jiuwen-adapter
Use JiuwenSwarm as the brain of dsh, with your other dsh plugins still working.
中文 · Quickstart · Config · dsh integration · Changelog
A Cordis plugin that registers a `jiuwen` provider on `ctx.llm`. dsh still handles the UI, sessions,
approvals and plugins. Each turn goes to the JiuwenSwarm Gateway, which runs its own agents, tools
and plugins. Each turn goes to the JiuwenSwarm Gateway, which runs its own agents, tools and memory.

## Features
| | What you get | Default |
| 🧠 **Jiuwen brain** | One dsh turn is one Gateway `chat.send`. Agents, team mode, skills and memory

run in Jiuwen | on |
| 💬 **Live activity** | Reasoning, 🔧 tool calls, subtasks and token usage stre

am into dsh | on |
| ✅ **dsh approvals and questions** | Jiuwen permission prompts, plan approval an

d `ask_user` go through dsh's own dialogs, and deny when no answer comes | on |
| 🔁 **Session contin

uity** | dsh sessions map to Jiuwen sessions. Only new text is sent after the first turn | on |
| 🛟
**Drop recovery** | If the Gateway drops mid-answer, the reply is recovered from history and marked

as recovered | on |
| 🧾 **Local titles and compaction** | Titles and `/compact` are handled locally,

so they never cost a Jiuwen turn | on |
| ⌨️ **`/jiuwen` command** | Sessions, models, modes, skill

s, agents, cron, MCP and more (list) | on |
| 🖼️ **Multimodal** | Image and file parts are sent as J

iuwen media | on |
| 🪪 **System prompt → Jiuwen** | `injectSystem: full\|persona` sends the host sys
tem prompt (any role/profile) once per Jiuwen session, resent only on change, capped by `injectSyste
mMaxBytes`. `injectSystemUpdate: diff` (default) resends only changed sections (safety gates may sti
ll send full); optional `hostSystemSectionsAllow`/`Deny` filter by heading; an optional `hostProfile
` object can name your host's persona sections. Hosts that need the full orchestrator role keep `ful

l`; ordinary dsh chats may use `persona`/`off` | default `full` (`off` to disable) |
| 📚 **Host skil
ls → Jiuwen** | Skills Jiuwen lacks go as an index (name + description) loaded on demand via the pas
sthrough `skill` tool, or inline bodies when that tool is absent; hash-gated across restarts, best-e

ffort secret redaction, `skillBodyMaxChars` cap with a truncation marker | default `index` |
| ⏹️ **
Interrupt on new message** | A user message that arrives while a Jiuwen turn is running interrupts i
t (`chat.interrupt`), coalesces everything that arrived meanwhile into one step, and resends with a
note that the previous turn was cut (side effects not rolled back). Waits for a pending approval car
d first (docs) | default `interrupt` (`onBusyMessage: queue` / `JIUWEN_ON_BUSY_MESSAGE=queue` for th

e old wait-until-done) |
| 🪜 **Full trajectory** | `trajectoryDetail: full` renders Jiuwen tool call
s, results, subtasks and plan steps as Markdown steps in the reasoning block | default `full` (`summ

ary` to disable) |
| 🔌 **dsh tools → Jiuwen** | All dsh host/plugin tools exposed to Jiuwen over MCP
by default (`toolAllowlist: '*'`; `core` = restricted shell/file + skill + session-query set, plus
`toolAllowlistExtra` and host-declared `passthrough: true`), each call gated by an approval. Per-ses
sion proxies are released on session end or after `mcpSessionIdleMs`, stale ones GC'd at start; reco

nnect only when the tool set changes | on with `hostSync` |
| 🎛️ **Per-profile overrides** | `sessio
nOverrides` by host agent preset (`preset` glob) sets model / chat mode / template defaults; request

, catalog and `/jiuwen mode` still win | opt-in |
| 🧭 **Bridges** | Model discovery, typed events |

opt-in |
| 🔄 **Host → Jiuwen sync** | Skills, MCP, model, plan, workDir, title, delete, goal, pause,

permissions, fork, schedules (docs) | on |
| 🩺 **Config validation** | Unknown keys get a "did you
mean" hint and deprecated keys get a warning. Never throws | on |
## Compatibility
Other dsh plugins must keep working. The adapter is tested against the **full dsh agent runtime** (`
dsh-agent`, `dsh-agent-loop`, compaction, subagents, goals, plan mode, a bash sandbox, approvals and
user-questions). The same scripted session runs once with jiuwen loaded and once without. Every row
of the compat matrix must match, covering events, tool calls, plan exit, goal rounds, auto-compacti
on, subagents, bash, host event counts, globals and load failures.
| Component | Supported | Tested in CI |

2` | 22, 24 |
| JiuwenSwarm | 0.2.x Gateway | 0.2.7 (live) |
The adapter also works in any Cordis app that has an `llm` service (usage).
